subject: Build Cloud Master P2 'Survive the Drift' (cloud-openstack-iac-harden). Already designed in _app/projects/ProjectsData.js: run your applier twice and nothing changes; break a resource by hand and it puts the environment back -- idempotency, drift detection, reconciliation. Needs a landing page at /projects/cloud-openstack-iac-harden.html (the Projects hub navigates to /projects/<id>.html by convention, which is why hasPage:false is currently CORRECT) plus a grader. P1's grader infrastructure already exists on bc1 (CLOUD_CHECKS + qc-lab.sh 'project' mode, both harnesses), so this is the cheapest of the two unbuilt projects. P3 'Same Intent, Different Cloud' (cloud-openstack-iac-translate) follows.
